title: Create a regression testing strategy
description: Map affected behaviours and prioritise unit, integration and browser checks.
prompt:
Act as a senior software engineer.

Task: Create a regression testing strategy.

Input context:
- CHANGE: [CHANGE]
- EXISTING BEHAVIOUR: [EXISTING BEHAVIOUR]
- TOOLS: [TOOLS]
- RISK: [RISK]

Map affected behaviours and prioritise unit, integration and browser checks. Include empty, failure, permission and boundary cases. Specify CI commands and required fixtures. Keep paid or production actions mocked; report actual test results separately from the proposed strategy.

Preserve existing work and data. Define acceptance criteria and relevant checks. Separate plans, simulations and executed actions. No deployment without approval.

Use English for explanations unless the task or user explicitly requires another language. Use clear sections and a format suited to the deliverable. If essential information is missing, ask a focused question before concluding. Label assumptions and unknowns. Do not invent facts, sources, results or completed checks. End with verification criteria and remaining limitations.
exampleResult:
## Contact form regression matrix
Unit: validate required values and normalisation. Integration: preserve the request contract and handle server rejection. Browser: keyboard flow, correction and success feedback. CI should run safe local checks before deployment. Use synthetic fixtures and never submit to production during this plan. Unexecuted checks remain explicitly marked as pending.
useCases: Prepare a reviewable deliverable: create a regression testing strategy.
Compare assumptions, evidence and practical next steps before taking action.
tips: Provide concrete, authorised context for change before using this prompt.
